purpose: Pre-register a geometry-matched local interface motif and hard-negative auxiliary before any training run.

validation: unchanged SAbDab2 development validation; no motif masks

mechanism.positive: authenticated native contact pairs whose antibody residue is in a CDR and antigen residue is on the isolated-antigen surface
mechanism.native_local_noncontact: non-contact pairs within the same antibody CDR and cognate antigen surface patches
mechanism.matched_local_decoy: a different same-antigen non-epitope surface patch matched without model scores on patch size, SASA/area, local-curvature proxy, amino-acid composition, center-distance and distance bin
candidate_restrictions: decoy center is surface and outside the authenticated epitope mask
the full decoy patch contains no authenticated epitope residue
the full decoy patch contains no native contact residue
ties are resolved by residue index

loss.name: positive-vs-local-decoy softplus margin
loss.native_local_noncontact_role: reported as a separate diagnostic tier; never silently merged into matched decoys or used as an unbalanced all-pairs loss
loss.normalization: mean over eligible complexes, not over all O(L_antibody*L_antigen) negatives

static: no decoy overlap with native contacts/epitope
promotion: matched five-seed development on epitope-group and surface-ratio splits
paired bootstrap on native contact macro/per-complex AUPRC
gates.stop_rule: If native contact primary or partner-specificity fails the pre-registered gate, retain the negative result and stop this branch.

authority.claim_boundary: Protocol and implementation only; no performance claim until a development-only run emits a receipt.
